name: Sequence Monitor
description: The sequence monitor function code controls the execution of a sequence generator block by selecting the order of step execution in a process based on system and external inputs. The sequence monitor block performs a logic action based on the value of the control status input from a device monitor block and a boolean step trigger input. Depending on the value of the control status input, the next step can be a fault step or a normal step determined by internal logic. The sequence monitor block can be placed in either automatic or semi-automatic mode, and includes hold/initialize and executed stop (E-STOP) inputs. Each sequence monitor block handles up to eight steps. If more than eight steps are required, a number of sequence monitor blocks can be chained together in series fashion with S1. The sequence monitor block defines step type, next step, and fault values for each step.
